1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi. Ni iya Dawidi.Mana njya mpimbaza ntuceceke,

2.text: Kuko banyasamiye akanwa k'umunyabyaha,Akanwa k'uburiganya,Bambwirishije ururimi rw'ibinyoma.

4.text: Urukundo rwanjye barwituye kuba abanzi bandwanya,Ariko jyeweho nitangira gusenga.

5.text: Ku neza nabagiriye banyituye inabi,Ku rukundo banyituye urwango.

7.text: Nacirwa urubanza asohoke rumutsinze,Gusenga kwe guhwanywe n'icyaha.

8.text: Iminsi yo kubaho kwe ibe mike,Ubutware bwe busubiremo undi.

9.text: Abana be babe impfubyi,Umugore we abe umupfakazi.

10.text: Abana be babe inzererezi basabirize,Bashakire ibyokurya kure y'umusaka wabo.

11.text: Umwishyuza atege ikigoyi ibyo afite byose,Abanyamahanga banyage ibyo yaruhiye.

12.text: Ntihazagire ukomeza kumugirira neza,Ntihazagire ubabarira impfubyi ze.

13.text: Urubyaro rwe ruzarimburwe,Mu gihe cy'abuzukuru be izina ryabo rizasibanganywe.

14.text: Gukiranirwa kwa ba sekuruza kwibukwe n'Uwiteka,Ibyaha bya nyina bye gusibanganywa.

15.text: Bibe imbere y'Uwiteka ubudasiba,Kugira ngo arimbure kwibukwa kwabo agukure mu isi.

16.text: Kuko wa wundi atibukaga kubabarira,Ahubwo yagenzaga umunyamubabaro n'umukene,N'ufite umutima umenetse ngo abice.

17.text: Yakundaga kuvuma, kuvuma kwe kumugeraho,Kandi ntiyishimiraga kwifuriza abantu umugisha,Umugisha ukamuba kure.

18.text: Kandi yambaraga kuvuma nk'umwenda we,Kwinjira mu nda ye nk'amazi,Kwinjira mu magufwa ye nk'amavuta.

20.text: Ibyo abe ari byo bihembo by'abanzi banjye bituruka ku Uwiteka,N'iby'abavuga nabi ubugingo bwanjye.

21.text: Ariko Uwiteka Mwami,Ku bw'izina ryawe unkorere ibyiza,Unkirize kuko imbabazi zawe ari nziza.

22.text: Kuko ndi umunyamubabaro n'umukene,Kandi umutima wanjye ukomerekeye muri jye.

24.text: Amavi yanjye aciwe urutebwe no kutarya,Umubiri wanjye unanuwe no kubura ibinure.

25.text: Kandi mpindukiye ba bandi igitutsi,Uko bambonye bazunguza imitwe.

26.text: Uwiteka Mana yanjye, untabare,Unkize nk'uko imbabazi zawe ziri,

27.text: Kugira ngo bamenye yuko ibyo ari ukuboko kwawe,Ko ari wowe Uwiteka wabikoze.

28.text: Bavume ariko wowe ho umpe umugisha,Nibahagaruka bazakorwa n'isoni,Ariko umugaragu wawe nzishima.

29.text: Abanzi banjye bambikwe igisuzugiriro,Bambare isoni zabo nk'umwitero.

30.text: Ndashimisha Uwiteka cyane akanwa kanjye,Nzamushimira mu iteraniro.

31.text: Kuko azahagararira iburyo bw'umukene,Kumukiza abacira ho iteka ubugingo bwe.
